summary: Conservation pledges dominate Mongolia’s ecosystem agenda, targeting a 44.9% overall GHG-emission reduction by 2030 and forest sequestration of -24.4 million t CO₂-eq by 2035, including about 3.3 Mt CO₂-eq of enhanced uptake over business as usual. Full international support could yield a conditional sequestration-based reduction of 3.9 Mt CO₂-eq by 2035, while protection is targeted to reach 33.1% of the country by 2035—30% plus an additional 3.1%—about 517,779 km² using the supplied land area. Another conservation measure would retain 6.4 km³ of meltwater in upstream basins. The mixed restoration-and-conservation pledge would restore 10% of heavily degraded steppe and forest-steppe rangelands, although no deadline or base area is stated. Grassland covers 21.9% of Mongolia, so this pledge cannot be compared directly with the full grassland class.
